title: Elastic throughput reservation with demotion lanes
creator: Arielle Kim
description: Implement an elastic throughput reservation system for Dedicated fleets that allows tenants to hold soft reservations of capacity and be automatically demoted to lower-priority lanes under sustained overload. The feature combines small reserved tokens for latency-sensitive traffic, adaptive demotion lanes for best-effort requests, and predictive short-window borrowing to smooth bursts without violating SLOs for critical classes.
acceptance_criteria: API: New fleet config accepts 'soft_reservation' (tokens/min), 'demotion_lanes' (N tiers) and 'borrow_window_ms' settings
Runtime: Requests tagged 'latency_class=critical' are served with >=99th percentile latency below configured SLO when aggregate usage is at or below (capacity + soft_reservations)
Demotion behavior: When capacity pressure persists > borrow_window_ms, non-critical requests are moved to demotion lanes with rate limits enforced per lane
Autoscaling interplay: Autoscaler can use reserved_token_utilization metric to prioritize scaling decisions by tenant
Safety: No tenant can starve system-critical control plane calls; control plane always has a hard reservation
Observability: Console shows tenant-level reserved vs used tokens, demotion lane sizes, and per-lane latency/cost impact for the last 7 days
design_decisions: Use token-bucket soft reservations allocated per tenant but accounted globally at fleet level to avoid fragmentation
Implement demotion lanes as logical rate-limiting bands inside the existing admission controller to reuse existing queuing and shedding hooks
Predictive borrowing: short-term borrow (configurable ms window) allowed beyond soft reservation for traffic spikes; borrowing decays linearly unless sustained
Autoscaler signals: export 'reserved_token_utilization' and 'demotion_pressure' metrics so Dedicated autoscaler can prioritize growth for tenants with active soft reservations
Fallback: If demotion lanes exceed threshold, fall back to best-effort shedder policy with soft-penalty-based responses to clients (Retry-After + structured code)
implementation_notes: Admission controller changes: add per-tenant bucket state keyed by tenant_id; persist light-weight state in in-memory cluster store with periodic checkpointing to redis for recovery
Queueing: reuse existing request queue but tag queued items with lane index and enqueue time to support lane-based dequeue prioritization
Metrics: expose per-tenant metrics via Prometheus -> console: reserved_tokens_total, reserved_tokens_used, demotion_lane_count, demotion_lane_drop_rate
Config: extend fleet config protobuf with soft_reservation, demotion_lanes[], borrow_window_ms; validate at config push time
Compatibility: ensure hosted API callers without tenant header default to a global soft_reservation=0 path to avoid changing behavior
test_plan: Unit tests for token accounting, borrow decay, and demotion lane selection
Integration test harness scenario: create 3 tenants with different soft_reservations and run mixed load to verify that critical classes maintain SLO while remaining requests are demoted
Chaos test: simulate delayed autoscaler signal and verify that demotion lanes prevent tail latency violations for critical traffic
Load test: run sustained 95% capacity + burst to confirm borrowing and decay operate within configured windows
E2E canary in dedicated staging with one small tenant enabled for 48 hours to observe production-like traffic patterns
rollout_plan: Feature gate: config flag 'enable_elastic_reservations' per fleet; default off
Stage 1: Internal teams opt-in on dedicated staging; monitor metrics and error budgets for 72 hours
Stage 2: Small customer pilot (2 tenants) enabled in a single region with SRE on-call and quick rollback runbook
Stage 3: Gradual ramp across fleets by traffic class; enable telemetry dashboards and set alert thresholds for demotion_pressure > 0.25
Rollback: provide API to set demotion_lanes=0 and soft_reservation=0 to revert to previous behavior immediately
monitoring_and_metrics: Per-tenant: reserved_tokens_total, reserved_tokens_used, borrow_inflight, demotion_lane_count, demotion_lane_drop_rate
SLOs: 99th percentile latency for latency_class=critical and success rate for control-plane calls
Alerts: demotion_pressure > 0.5 for 5m, reserved_tokens_used > reserved_tokens_total + 20% sustained for 1m
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Soft reservations may be gamed by noisy tenants. Mitigation: add per-tenant fair-share cap and monitor anomalous reservation churn
Risk: State explosion if many tenants reserve tokens. Mitigation: cap active soft_reservation entries and evict least-recently-used reservations, exposing eviction metrics
Risk: Autoscaler thrash if it interprets short borrows as sustained load. Mitigation: expose borrow_window_ms metric and autoscaler debounce policy suggested in docs
Risk: Interactions with private deployments where telemetry is limited. Mitigation: ship local-mode minimal metrics and allow ops to opt-out of borrowing
dependencies: SRE: alerting runbook update and on-call coverage for pilot
console-frontend: dashboard tiles for reservation visualization (tracked in PM)
